name: Straitcowl
description: Stand sideways with the long blade levelled at the foe's chest and the rear leg bearing the weight.

name: Firm Hardtip
description: Straighten the sword arm and drive the point along the shortest line to the foe's breastbone.

name: Rigidtang Amble
description: Draw the point back along its own line and slide the front foot behind it to regain stance.

name: Even Stiffspine
description: Wrap both hands about the long grip so the point stays steady through each push.

name: Nabbing Squaretip
description: Drop the point toward the knee, then snap it up to the throat to pull the foe's guard low.

name: Straithusk
description: Knock the incoming blade wide with the flat of the estoc and turn the point back at the foe.

name: Holding Longtang
description: Hold the estoc upright before the face with both hands and keep the elbows tucked against the ribs.

name: Wide Trianglespine
description: Push the sword arm out in one line from the shoulder so the point lands where the eyes were fixed.

name: Drillamble
description: Slide the lead foot forward a hand's breadth and bring the rear foot after it without crossing the legs.

name: Holding Squarepoint
description: Turn the wrist outward so the flat of the blade pushes a cut off its line.

name: Bracespine Review
description: Count the foe's steps aloud while holding guard to learn the distance at which the point reaches.

name: Open Bore
description: Drive the point into a standing wooden post again and again, aiming for the same small mark each time.

name: Gouge Hit
description: Throw the front foot forward as the arm extends, landing the point at the moment the heel strikes the ground.

name: Swaying Thrustspine
description: Pull the rear foot beneath the hips and draw the point home before the foe can counter.

name: Resting Stiffblade
description: Strike the foe's blade from below with the flat and lift it clear of the centre line.

name: Shifting Skewer
description: Close the distance in half paces with the point held steady at the foe's chest height.

name: Narrow Impale
description: Reverse the hilt and knock the heavy pommel against the foe's jaw or ribs when too close for the point.

name: Fixing Hardtip
description: Lay the blade across the foe's and press until their point slides off line, then keep the pressure steady.

name: Judging Stiffspine
description: Learn to feel the four flat faces of the blade in the hand so it never turns crooked on the thrust.

name: Piercehit
description: Thrust at four marks on a hanging board, throat, chest, belly and thigh, returning to guard between each.

name: Gnawing Drill
description: Spring from the rear foot so the whole body follows the point in a single forward line.

name: Slenderlid
description: Hold the point low and forward beside the knee, ready to rise, while the foe approaches.

name: Backward Rigidtang
description: Step backward on the balls of the feet while keeping the point levelled at the foe's face.

name: Tautpause
description: Beat the foe's thrust aside with the broad face of the square blade and step off the line.

name: Borehit
description: Slam the crossguard against the foe's wrist during a close bind to break their grip.

name: Level Bore
description: Thrust, recover and thrust again at an even beat to teach the body to chain two strokes.

name: Calm Squarepoint
description: Stand a blade's length from a mark and note exactly where the point stops when fully extended.

name: Level Pierce
description: Step in and send the point straight along the line of the foe's chest in one unbroken push.

name: Slendernote
description: Grip the blade's middle with a gloved off hand to shorten the weapon and steady aim for close work.

name: Pierce Pace
description: Slip one foot aside as the foe thrusts so the blade passes by the ribs and the point stays level.

name: Slenderwedge
description: Catch the foe's cut on the crossguard and twist the wrist to throw it away from the body.

name: Tautcowl
description: Plant the rear foot and angle the point at the oncoming foe's chest so their rush meets it.

name: Backward Trianglespine
description: Pivot on the lead foot while the point tracks the foe, turning the body without lowering the blade.

name: Single Longtang
description: Send a thread of qi along the blade as the lunge lands, adding bite to the final inch.

name: Gougeamble
description: Step diagonally off the foe's line so their thrust passes the shoulder while the point stays on target.

name: Tending Squaretip
description: Hold the breath at the top of the draw so the qi settles in the arm before the thrust.

name: Gougeskitter
description: Plant the back heel hard after the lunge and push to return to guard in one motion.

name: Straitstay
description: Tilt the point across the foe's blade and carry it outward, turning aside a direct thrust.

name: Locking Thrustspine
description: Stamp the forward foot to startle the foe's rhythm, then thrust into the broken timing.

name: Square Impale
description: Aim the point at the narrow gap between helm and breastplate and drive through with a short push of qi.

name: Boreblow
description: Lift the foe's arm aside with the off hand and place the point in the open armpit.

name: Straitcount
description: Slide the point along a plate until it catches an edge, then press lightly to learn where the seam lies.

name: Descending Bracespine
description: Tap the point against the visor's slit to jar the foe's sight and unsettle the stance.

name: Solid Stiffblade
description: Pull back from a failed thrust with the point crossing the body so the foe's answer meets steel.

name: Solid Hardtip
description: Plant a wide stance with both hands on the long grip and the point levelled at the foe's belt.

name: Gouge Dash
description: Turn the hips into the lunge so the weight of the whole body follows the point.

name: Mild Bracespine
description: Anchor the rear hand against the hip and let qi pool in the forearm to steady the heavy blade.

name: Light Drill
description: Roll the weight from heel to toe in a long step that never lets the point drift upward.

name: Slenderhusk
description: Swing the long blade against the foe's weapon and use its weight to hurl the strike aside.

name: Fouling Skewer
description: Hook the foe's weapon arm with the crossguard and haul it off line before thrusting.

name: Slenderstrike
description: Whip the pommel round in a short arc and smash it into the foe's temple or collarbone.

name: Upward Stiffblade
description: Lunge, stab, then spring back to guard in a single practiced pair so the foe cannot answer.

name: Wide Skewer
description: Aim the narrow tip at the centre of a mail ring so the point parts the links as it enters.

name: Warm Rigidtang
description: Press the point against padded leather and feel for the stitched seam where it will give.

name: Downward Longtang
description: Thrust at a shirt of mail hung from a beam, repeating until every thrust finds the same gap.

name: Skipping Thrustspine
description: Plant each foot flat and firm so a thrust against plate drives from the legs and not the arm.

name: Borewedge
description: Flick the point toward an exposed strap, then shift it to the true target as the foe's guard follows.

name: Angled Squarepoint
description: Draw the blade across the chest with the point high and the off hand free to ward.

name: Stiffspine Husk
description: Lay the strong of the blade across the foe's and hold it there with a thin stream of qi.

name: Leaden Bore
description: Slide the point along the foe's blade from the bind and drive it into the opening beside the hilt.

name: Shifting Gouge
description: Give ground with a step as the foe presses the bind, letting their force carry them forward.

name: Fixing Drill
description: Let go of the bind all at once so the foe stumbles into the thrust that follows.

name: Soft Trianglespine
description: Read through the blades whether the foe is pushing, yielding or about to slip free.

name: Holding Squaretip
description: Rotate the blade outward over the foe's to carry their point away from the body.

name: Nimble Impale
description: Drop the point under the foe's blade and step clear of a bind that is going against you.

name: Tautstay
description: Hold the estoc at rest with the point near the ground and the grip close to the hip.

name: Drillstrike
description: Extend the arm and step so the point travels in a straight line into the belly.

name: Drilldrop
description: Press the point into a yielding target and keep pushing with steady qi until the guard breaks.

name: Easing Longtang
description: Walk toward the foe at an even pace with the point never wavering from their centre.

name: Lowered Stiffspine
description: Strike the foe's weapon outward with the flat and leave the point already aimed for the return.

name: Short Rigidtang
description: Lunge fully and hold the stretched position for a breath to show the thrust is truly landed.
